theme: Ngân sách & cắt giảm chi phí

vocab.example: The board asked every department to prepare a cost-cutting plan.
vocab.example_vi: Hội đồng quản trị yêu cầu mọi phòng ban chuẩn bị kế hoạch cắt giảm chi phí.

vocab.example: Our headcount will stay the same until the end of the year.
vocab.example_vi: Số lượng nhân sự của chúng ta sẽ giữ nguyên đến cuối năm.

vocab.example: Because of the hiring freeze, we cannot replace Lan this quarter.
vocab.example_vi: Vì tạm dừng tuyển dụng, chúng ta không thể tuyển người thay Lan trong quý này.

vocab.example: The marketing team is ten percent over budget this month.
vocab.example_vi: Đội marketing đang vượt ngân sách mười phần trăm trong tháng này.

vocab.example: We can reallocate the travel budget to staff training.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta có thể phân bổ lại ngân sách công tác sang đào tạo nhân viên.

vocab.example: Please keep five percent of the budget as a contingency.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy giữ năm phần trăm ngân sách làm khoản dự phòng.

vocab.example: We plan to phase out printed reports by next March.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi dự định loại bỏ dần báo cáo in giấy trước tháng Ba năm sau.

vocab.example: Switching to a new internet provider brought savings of 20 million a year.
vocab.example_vi: Đổi sang nhà cung cấp internet mới giúp tiết kiệm 20 triệu mỗi năm.

lines.speaker: Phương (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Thanks for coming, Đức. As you know, the company wants a cost-cutting plan for next quarter.

lines.speaker: Đức (Admin Manager)
lines.text: Yes, I saw the email. How much do we need to cut?

lines.speaker: Phương (Finance Manager)
lines.text: About eight percent. Your department was over budget last quarter, mainly because of printing.

lines.speaker: Đức (Admin Manager)
lines.text: That's true. We could phase out printed reports and use shared folders instead.

lines.speaker: Phương (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Good idea. How much savings do you expect from that?

lines.speaker: Đức (Admin Manager)
lines.text: Maybe fifteen million per quarter. What about headcount? I wanted to hire one more assistant.

lines.speaker: Phương (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Sorry, there is a hiring freeze until January. But we can reallocate some money to overtime if needed.

lines.speaker: Đức (Admin Manager)
lines.text: OK, that helps. Should I keep any money for emergencies?

lines.speaker: Phương (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Yes, keep a small contingency, around three percent. Please send me your plan by Friday.

lines.speaker: Đức (Admin Manager)
lines.text: No problem. I will send it on Thursday afternoon.

questions.q: Why was Đức's department over budget?
Why can't Đức hire a new assistant?
How much should Đức keep as a contingency?

shadowing: We need to cut our operating costs by eight percent next quarter.
Our department was slightly over budget last month because of extra printing.
Can we reallocate part of the travel budget to the training program?
Because of the hiring freeze, we will not add any new staff this year.
Please keep a small contingency in case we have unexpected costs.
